meta.title: DeepSeek Chat
meta.description: Adds a chat.deepseek.com panel to the sidebar, a configurable conversation-header tab (default "DeepSeek Chat"), and a right-sidebar card that registers through better-sidebar when its service is running or injects directly into DSH native right sidebar otherwise (default "DeepSeek Chat", independently toggleable and renameable): fills the whole conversation area, remembers the last conversation, keeps a stable login session, and offers a settings page to toggle/rename both surfaces, show plugin metadata (version, author, description, license, npm/GitHub links), check for updates against npm/GitHub, and — when a new version is found — show an "Update now" button that really calls the official DSH Host channel pluginManager.updateBundle for a one-click update with honest success / restart / failure states — pure web chat with no account status strip.
